Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
The parameters
dataID
,
sourceID
,
messageType
and
messageResult
for
E2E_XXmProtect
method are passed as described in chapter 7.4.1.2.2.2.
After E2E protection the non E2E protected part is added to message as described in
specification [SWS_CM_10464].
Figure 7.27 shows the message flow of sending a
Set()
method. The figure does
not list all details of E2E protection, e.g. functions of libraries E2ELib and CrcLib are
omitted in this figure.
The client application calls the
Set()
function at
ara::com
with one argument (the
value that shall overwrite the field’s value).
